URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/netanyahu-says-omani-copilot-who-tried-to-bring-down-flight-underwent-islamist-radical-indoctrination/
The Times of Israel — confirmed published 1 October 2026, 17:38 GMT (18:38 BST).
Headline: "Netanyahu says Omani copilot who tried to bring down flight underwent 'Islamist radical indoctrination'"

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Thursday asserted that the Omani first officer who stabbed the pilot on the flydubai flight "underwent Islamist radical indoctrination." While Netanyahu did not elaborate, an Israeli official told The Times of Israel that the copilot discussed killing Jews on social media.

QUOTE (unnamed Israeli official, to The Times of Israel): "This was a person who was willing to commit suicide. His social media accounts [say] clearly that he has been radicalized into jihadist ideology. He talks about killing Jews."

QUOTE (Benjamin Netanyahu, Prime Minister of Israel, to Fox News): "The attacker, he calls out to the aircrew, 'Kill me, kill me,'" making it "clear he was suicidal."

QUOTE (Netanyahu): "I think it's too early to say whether there was Iranian collusion," adding that he anticipated more definitive findings soon. Israel will be able to state conclusively within the coming days whether the copilot had any links to Iran.

It was the second time the prime minister spoke to Fox News in 24 hours.

Netanyahu said Saudi Arabia, which was holding the copilot, would "I assume, very quickly" transfer him to Dubai. "He's an Omani national... We'll join the interrogation and find out what happened there exactly."

Israel has diplomatic relations with the UAE but the two countries have no bilateral extradition treaty. The Emirati chief prosecutor announced Thursday that it was investigating the copilot for "terrorist activity or intent."
